title: Emerald Oasis
meta_description: Emerald Oasis --- bright 2-suite 30A retreat with balcony, communal pool \& hot tub, minutes from sugar-white beaches and Gulf Place.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Emerald Oasis, your breezy coastal getaway perfectly placed in Santa Rosa Beach---one of 30A's most cherished stretches for beach lovers, foodies, and travelers seeking the calm, sophisticated energy of the Emerald Coast. From this convenient location, you're just minutes from the area's sugar-white beaches, scenic walking and biking paths, and popular local spots such as Gulf Place and Shunk Gulley.

Inside, the home opens into a bright, spacious living area designed for both relaxation and connection. A reclining leather sofa invites you to settle in for long conversations or cozy movie nights on the expansive TV, while the open layout creates an easy flow into the kitchen and dining spaces. The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need for effortless meals, complete with four bar stools at the counter for casual breakfasts or pre-dinner cocktails. Step out onto the porch to enjoy peaceful treetop views---a serene backdrop for morning coffee or a quiet pause between beach adventures. For added convenience, an in-unit washer and dryer makes longer stays feel truly seamless.

The two bedroom suites offer the comfort and privacy of a boutique stay. The primary bedroom is a serene haven with a king-size bed and soft, calming light. Its ensuite bathroom features a spacious walk-in shower and a clean, modern design that elevates your morning or evening routine. The second bedroom is equally inviting, furnished with two queen beds that comfortably accommodate families or friends. It also has its own ensuite bath with a shower-and-tub combo---perfect for guests who prefer the option of a relaxing soak after a day in the sun.

Just steps from your door, you'll find resort-style amenities that enhance every part of your stay. The communal pool provides the perfect cool-down on warm Florida afternoons, the hot tub invites slow, easy evenings, and the fitness center ensures your routines stay on track.

Whether you're here for a family getaway, a beach escape with friends, or a refreshing change of pace, Emerald Oasis offers a bright, modern, and incredibly convenient home base in the heart of 30A.

AvantStay provides an upscale experience with services that elevate your stay and save time so you can enjoy every moment. Guests have access to a 24/7 support team and a tech-enabled concierge to book services, such as fridge stocking, mid-stay cleanings, and private chefs. For anything you need (or never knew you needed), we're at your service!

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: Rosemary Beach, The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Please note your home comes equipped with a pack'n'play.
- Guests can rent bikes and golf carts from a trusted third-party vendor---reach out to us for more information.

Parking Details:
- Parking is available in any unnumbered spot

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

TDT Registration: #232960
